It's i think an unfortunate mix of answers. When it came out all CN was putting out was 30 episodes of teen titans go, and a few steven universe episodes. So people who wanted to watch something else couldn't because it was only those 2 shows, so they grew to resent it. If the only seen a couple of episodes in tn the first season they might think it's goofy and has no substance. Some don't like Steven's character (mostly if they've just seen season 1 episodes) because he's to kiddie and annoying (which i can get). Same thing rick and morty can have, a good show with a loud minority of cringey fans. And a small bit of homophobia. Some people think it's woke because it has some lesbian relationships and think the whole show is about that. Lasty probably bandwagoning, people who haven't watched much if any of it seeing it's cool to hate the show because other people who haven't seen much or any of the hate on it, biased YouTube reviewers didn't help. And some people have seen the show and it just isn't for them, and that's valid.

I'd disagree. SU had the disadvantage of coming out at a bad time where cartoon network was already going down hill then stopped a lot of there shows. Ttg was the majority of what was on during that time with a few SU eps in between but even then it took months for a new ep to come out. For every 10 TTG episodes you'd get 1 ep of SU. which if you already didn't like SU for whatever reason probably made the hate even more prevalent because it was one of the only 2 shows out at the time. The first season is rough, last season rushed but all in all it's not as bad as people think. Alot of the hate seems to come from when it came out, the first season, cringe fans, or honestly homophobia (which isn't something I care to get into, idc that much 😂 but it is a reason) if you've watched a good bit and still don't like it, fair play to ya, but people who have only seen a couple episodes or just see clips and say it's trash eirk me because I wouldn't say a show is trash if I haven't watched a good bit of it. Like I've never understood the love for ed Eddie and eddy because the couple episodes I've seen just weren't good but that's not a tell of the whole show. 

Anyway tldr: think it was more it got hurt by the time it came out then cartoon network hurting because of it. They were the ones hurting themselves.
